audit.whatIsWrong: All seven chart rows disagreed with the packet and with their own why-text. The page read Jax/Skill/Shen/Shen/Jax/Shen/Shen while whys[0] says 'neither of you wins the opener', whys[1] and whys[2] describe your level 2-3 spike, and whys[3] through whys[6] all say the lane levels out or 'stays even'.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Skill/Jax/Jax/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill at 49.25% over 1131 games — an even lane with a Jax window at 2-3. Every why already argued exactly that; only the enum rows were wrong.
audit.corrected: Rows set to Skill / Jax / Jax / Skill / Skill / Skill / Skill in both layers, ratings realigned to 5, 7, 7, 5, 5, 5, 5.

audit.why: Four spikes present: your level 2-3 Counter Strike window, level 6 (your R 110/100/90s against Stand United, a 200/180/160s global), Trinity Force, and Shen's ult as a permanent map spike rather than a duel one. That last framing is right — Shen's threat is never the 1v1.

audit.whatIsWrong: The matchup-defining interaction was named only loosely. The focus and every cooldown line point at Shadow Dash, but the ability that actually decides the trade is Spirit's Refuge, and no cooldown number appeared anywhere.
audit.why: Spirit's Refuge blocks attacks that would hit Shen near his spirit blade — 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s. Counter Strike's value is dodging autos and stunning; a Shen who blocks instead of swinging denies the dodge half entirely, which is exactly why the lane flattens from level 4. Shadow Dash is a 600-range taunt on 18/16/14/12/10s at 150 mana — the tell, not the decider. Twilight Assault also does max-health damage, so your health bar is not the buffer stacking resistances suggests.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now lists both Shadow Dash's and Spirit's Refuge's real cooldowns; report[5].t and phases[3].why state the block interaction as the reason the lane levels out; dosFull[0].d carries the 14s rank-3 taunt.

audit.whatIsWrong: Same as point 4 — the punishable cooldown was listed without numbers and pointed at the wrong ability.
audit.why: Shadow Dash costs 150 mana on top of a 14-18s cooldown, so a spent taunt is a long window; but the window you actually want is Spirit's Refuge down, since that is what stops your damage.

edits.before: Auto-trade only with E held in your pocket. Identify how Shen contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: You have one ability and Spirit's Refuge blocks the auto you would swing — farm the opener and set up your level 2.

edits.before: Counter Strike flips every AA exchange he starts. Only take the trade when Shen's Shadow Dash is down.
edits.after: Empower loaded into Leap Strike bursts harder than anything a taunt trade returns — take the level-2 exchange.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Shen must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Counter Strike eats his Q-empowered autos and the Shadow Dash taunt, then stuns — your cleanest punish before his W discipline.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Shadow Dash's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: A disciplined Shen blocks your swings with Spirit's Refuge (10s at rank 5) instead of feeding Counter Strike — the lane levels out.

edits.before: Grandmaster’s Might stats win every extended duel from here on. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Shen's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Your ultimate's Armor/MR wins the 1v1, but Stand United is global on a 200s rank-1 cooldown — his 6 is played on the map, not here.

edits.before: Trinity Force is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Shadow Dash's cooldown.
edits.after: Trinity Force out-duels his tank items, but he shoves and roams, so the edge never fully converts.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Shen carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: You out-duel a lone Shen at two items, but he is a teamfight tool, not a splitpusher — it stays even where it counts.

edits.before: His engage CC. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Shadow Dash is a 600-range taunt, 14s at rank 3 — bait it first.

edits.before: - Shen Shadow Dash: matchup-defining — His engage CC. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Shen Shadow Dash: 18/16/14/12/10s, a 600-range taunt at 150 mana — bait it. - Spirit's Refuge: 16s at rank 1, the real block on your damage. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only, never chip.

edits.before: Track Shen's Shadow Dash (Taunt): His engage CC. Dodge it. When it is down — Q-E-W him.
edits.after: Spirit's Refuge blocks attacks, so a good Shen never feeds Counter Strike. Punish it down.
